title: Component Gap Report
description: Emitted by the design agent whenever a ticket needs a component or variant the manifest doesn't have (or only has as 'proposed'). A human reviews this report; approved items get promoted into the manifest's components[] registry with status: approved, so later tickets reuse them instead of regenerating near-duplicates.

manifestVersion.description: meta.version of the manifest this report was generated against.

gapType.description: missing-component: no existing entry fits this category/purpose at all. missing-variant: the base component exists (e.g. Button) but not in the needed flavor (e.g. 'icon-only').

existingComponent.description: For missing-variant gaps: the component this would extend, e.g. 'Button'.

suggestedName.description: Proposed name for the new component or variant, e.g. 'StatTile' or 'icon-only'.

rationale.description: Why the ticket needs this and why nothing approved already covers it.

recommendation.description: The agent's suggestion. 'reuse-nearest-approved' means the gap is real but the agent thinks an approved component can be adapted instead of adding a new one — use this to push back on registry sprawl.

nearestApprovedAlternative.description: Set when recommendation is reuse-nearest-approved — names the existing component/variant to use instead.
